text.en:
Aiming Down Sights for #e${1.5-#d} seconds without firing causes your next shot to apply <void/>Weaken.

Timer starts as soon as ADS input is pressed.

enhanced (
var d = 0.1
#e Activation time is decreased by 0.1? seconds.
)

Aiming Down Sights for #e${1.5-#d} seconds without firing causes your Direct Hit to apply <void/>Weaken.

Timer starts as soon as ADS input is pressed.

enhanced (
var d = 0.1
#e Activation time is decreased by 0.1? seconds.
)

Aiming Down Sights for #e${1.5-#d} seconds without firing causes your next Direct Hit to apply <void/>Weaken.

Timer starts as soon as ADS input is pressed.

enhanced (
var d = 0.1
#e Activation time is decreased by 0.1 seconds.
)

Aiming Down Sights (ADS) for #e${1.5-#d} seconds without firing causes your next Direct Hit to apply <void/>Weaken.

Timer starts as soon as ADS input is pressed.

enhanced (
var d = 0.1
#e Activation time is decreased by 0.1 seconds.
)

Aiming Down Sights (ADS) for #e${1.5-#d} seconds without firing and staying ADS causes your next shot to apply <void/>Weaken on a Direct Hit.

Timer starts as soon as ADS input is pressed.

var d = 0.1
#e Activation time is decreased by 0.1 seconds.
